label: Names of libraries and tools that send web (HTTP) requests, in code or in text about code: Python's requests, urllib/urllib2/urllib3, http.client, httpx, aiohttp, and their kin in other languages (axios, okhttp, Go's http.Client, Ruby's net/http, curl). Server-side web code (Flask's request object, request handlers, web frameworks), other libraries (numpy, subprocess, sqlite3, smtplib, selenium) and everyday English 'request(s)' or 'curl' stay quiet; an everyday word like 'curl' can fire weakly only when it comes right after code.
